title: Prescreen Result
description: Output of tools/prescreen_signal.py. Contains ic_all_bars, ic_active_bars, significance on active-bar n, turnover proxy, and cost_check. A8.1: no standalone pass state — proceed_to_backtest requires both ic_significance AND cost_check.pass. A8.3: gate evaluates ic_active_bars; ic_all_bars also reported for A2.1 ungated-escape use.

run_id.description: Run identifier this prescreen belongs to

config_sha8.description: First 8 chars of SHA-256 of the strategy config

computed_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this prescreen was computed

prescreen_windows_used.description: Walk-forward window labels actually evaluated (full range = all windows)

n_bars_total.description: Total forecast records (bars where strategy was ready) across all symbols

ic_all_bars.description: A8.3: Spearman(forecast, next_return) over ALL bars including inactive (forecast=0). Used for A2.1 ungated-escape assessment (not for the IC gate).

ic_active_bars.description: A8.3: Spearman(forecast, next_return) restricted to bars where |forecast| > threshold. Used for the IC gate and cost_check (ic_used='ic_active_bars').

forecast_sparsity_pct.description: A8.3: percentage of forecast bars where forecast is inactive (|forecast| <= threshold). High sparsity explains ic_all_bars < ic_active_bars.

active_n_bars.description: A8.3: count of bars where |forecast| > threshold. Used as n for block-adjusted significance.

forecast_hash.description: A6.4: SHA-256 prefix of the serialized forecast series over the protocol range. Identical hashes = identical signal = one trial for deflation purposes.

ic_spearman_pooled.description: Legacy field: equals ic_active_bars for backward compatibility with older orchestrator code.

ic_by_regime.description: SUSPENDED per A2.3: ungated IC only until a trustworthy detector exists.

ic_significance.description: Block-adjusted significance computed on active_n_bars (A8.3). The gate: significant=true AND ic_active_bars > 0 are required for proceed_to_backtest.

block_size.description: Block size for autocorrelation adjustment (default 24 for 1h)

active_bars_total.description: Count of bars where |forecast| > threshold (= active_n_bars)

implied_trades_estimated.description: Estimated trade count from forecast sign changes

avg_holding_bars.description: active_bars_total / implied_trades_estimated. Used in cost_check formula.

forecast_sparsity_pct.description: Duplicate of top-level field for in-object reference convenience

sigma_bar_bps.description: Estimated std dev of 1-bar close returns in bps across all bars

cost_check.description: Layer 2 cost hurdle (Improvement 09). A8.1: always present. Formula: abs(ic_active_bars) * sigma_bar_bps * sqrt(avg_holding_bars). Pass = ratio >= safety_factor.

symbol.description: Primary symbol used for cost lookup

cost_bps_per_trade.description: From config/cost_model.yaml round_trip_cost_bps for the primary symbol

route.description: Routing decision. A8.1: proceed_to_backtest requires BOTH ic_significance.significant AND cost_check.pass.

route_rationale.description: One-sentence rationale citing the specific metric values that drove the route decision

prescreen_kill_reason.description: Mechanism failure label for verdict_interpreter when route is kill_*
